messages:
support-maya: Customer reported a spike of 502/504s and timeouts hitting hosted inference API since ~03:18 UTC. They've also reported being billed for requests that returned 5xx. Escalating. Request id sample: req_6f3b9a. Customer: acme-ml. Any visibility? :rotating_light:

auth-jordan: Seeing corresponding increase in 5xx from gateway. SLO burn alert fired: slo-alert-bot posted: "API gateway 5xx rate > 2% for 5m". Grafana panel: https://grafana.internal/g/abcd/gateway-5xx

sre-alex: Looking at logs. Top 5xx is 504 gateway_timeout and 502 bad_gateway. Traces show proxy timeout to runtime pools. Some backends returning 200 slow, others drop. Query I ran in Kibana:

```
index=prod-gateway logs | filter(status>=500) | stats count() by status,upstream_host | sort -count
```

Result: majority from upstream 10.12.5.21 (runtime-pool-3) and 10.12.5.22.

obs-bot: trace-sampling reduced to 5% at 03:00 UTC due to config change. That might explain missing traces.

eng-ryan: I'm seeing a recent routing policy change rolled out at 02:58 UTC that added latency-based routing to new quantized model variants. Could be uneven fan-out. Rollout id: rollout-2026-03-15-quant.

support-maya: Customer says they did not change anything client-side. They have a repro curl that consistently hits 504 after 10s on same token. Shared below.

oncall-jordan: Paste repro:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-abc" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-6b-quant","input":"hello","timeout":10000}'
```

sre-alex: Reproduced locally from prod VPC via a debug token, got 504 with upstream reset in tcpdump. Stack traces show connection reset by peer in proxy->runtime handshake. Suspect runtime OOM or process crash under qps spike.

eng-runtime-lee: We had a config change to autoscaler thresholds at 02:45 to reduce cold starts (min_replicas lowered from 3 to 1). That could explain pool starvation when traffic spiked.

sre-alex: Correlating: traffic spike at 03:17 with a burst of short chat sessions from a customer cohort. Autoscaler didn't react fast enough due to lowered min_replicas. Runtime pool had a transient CPU saturation on nodes 5/6.

support-maya: Billing-claire: customer expects credits if they were billed for failed requests. Can billing confirm which requests charged? sample billing id: bill_7890.

billing-claire: Will investigate. Need list of request ids and timestamps. Maya, can you ask customer for full request header dump? I can start a refund if we confirm.

sre-alex: Immediate mitigations: 1) revert autoscaler min_replicas to 3 (eng-runtime-lee) 2) add 10s longer proxy timeout as temporary measure (eng-platform-kim) 3) add emergency scaling policy for hot cohorts (eng-runtime-lee)

eng-runtime-lee: Reverted min_replicas -> 3 at 03:32 UTC. Patch: kubectl apply -f autoscaler-patch.yaml

eng-platform-kim: Increased proxy upstream timeout from 10s -> 20s in gateway config at 03:35 UTC. Deployed via canary->prod in 2min.

obs-bot: SLO burn alert cleared at 03:44 UTC. 5xx rate down to 0.8%.

sre-alex: Post-mortem hypothesis: combined change (routing policy + lower min replicas) caused hot routing to a small subset of runtime pods, which saturated and led to proxy 504s. Trace sampling reduction made detailed traces sparse.

support-maya: Customer confirmed reduced errors after ~03:40 and asked for refund. Shared full header/logs. Will send to billing-claire.

billing-claire: Prepared provisional credit for bill_7890, will finalize after cross-check with request ids.

sre-alex: Follow-ups: 1) eng-runtime to add autoscaler runbook and emergency scaling knob (due EOD) 2) eng-platform to add a dashboard showing min_replicas vs 5xx correlation (due tomorrow) 3) obs to revert sampling change or increase sampling during SLO burn windows. I'll own the postmortem writeup.

eng-runtime-lee: I'll open jira RWDOPS-4123 with steps and include kernel/core dumps we found.

sre-alex: Thanks everyone. Adding snippet of tcpdump and proxy log that shows RST:

```
proxy.log: upstream=10.12.5.21:443 method=POST path=/v1/generate status=504 runtime_err="upstream reset by peer" req=req_6f3b9a
```

support-maya: tagging customer thread with status "credit_pending" and sending a short note. :white_check_mark:

oncall-jordan: Closing thread here, please add to postmortem doc when ready.
